reviews.notes: Bare front/rear: connected torso, limb and wrist silhouette; retained hair and head.
Formal front/rear: unfolded trousers and full coat, joined cuffs/shoes, skin covered; no detached display trousers.
Warm formal: longer wool outer coat and glove material distinct, joined neck/wrists; retained silhouette.
Summer casual: forearms exposed only below cuffs; trouser hem reaches shoes. Coarse separate hip/leg construction remains visible and awaits artistic review.
Casual mid-season and winter: distinct jacket/coat/waistcoat and materials; covered forearms, aligned gloves/ankle boots.
Country summer/mid-season: sash, bombachas and country hat readable; hip/leg outlines are visibly separate. Refine continuous worn trousers before final approval.
REJECT source07: seated poncho follows hands and tears visually into folded strips. Formal sleeping articulation connected, but camera crops feet; later capture framing must fit horizontal poses.
